name: Zayed University
englishBachelors: Business, communication and media, technological innovation, humanities and social sciences, taught in English.
note: A federal university originally founded for Emirati women and now co-educational at some levels, with campuses in both Abu Dhabi and Dubai. International intake is limited and prioritised behind nationals.
summary: Federal university with campuses in Abu Dhabi and Dubai and six colleges offering bachelor's degrees in design, business, media, international studies, health sciences and IT.
about: Zayed University publishes 2027-28 admission criteria. International students apply through an e-services form, and admission is competitive, with priority for higher results and recent graduates.

ib.text: IB Diploma: minimum 24 points. IB certificate: minimum 21 points including 2 subjects related to the degree, each at grade 4+. Degrees add English, Maths and science minimums on a school-percentage scale.

noDeadline: Application dates to be confirmed; no closing date published
notes: IB entry (2027-28 criteria): the IB Diploma needs 24 points. IB certificate holders need 21 points including two subjects related to the degree with a grade of at least 4. British A-Levels need two at grade C.

Degree rules are given as school percentages or test scores, with no IB conversion: Architecture, business, IT and most science degrees ask 80% in English (or TOEFL iBT 72) and 80% in Maths (or SAT Math 530). Intelligent Systems Engineering asks 85% English (TOEFL iBT 79), 85% Maths (SAT Math 590) and 80% in Physics plus one more science. Media and Communication also asks 80% in Arabic; International Studies, Graphic/Interior Design and Visual Arts need no Maths. Ask how IB grades map.
English proof: 80% in Grade 12 English or TOEFL iBT 72 (79 for engineering) from an authorised test centre; TOEFL Home Edition is not accepted. Whether an IB English grade qualifies is not stated.

Dates: the application page says application dates are to be confirmed. Decisions are released in the final admission period (August for Fall). International students apply through the e-services form; non-MOE school certificates need a UAE Ministry of Education equivalency.

Fees: tuition AED 2,500 per credit hour for non-national (international) students, and an application fee of AED 250 plus VAT. Instalments are allowed. The page does not name the academic year, so the 2027-28 rate is not confirmed.
Selection: admission is competitive; priority goes to higher results and applicants who graduated more recently, by programme capacity. Meeting the minimum does not guarantee a place.

Teaching language: no explicit sentence on the language of instruction was found. English proof is required for every degree and the programme pages are in English; Media and Communication also needs Arabic. Confirm before applying. Programme durations are not stated on the pages checked, so individual programmes are not listed.
Campuses: Abu Dhabi and Dubai. The page does not say which degrees run on which campus; ask the admissions teams.

faculties.name: College of Arts and Creative Enterprises
faculties.line: Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Visual Arts; Architecture asks 80% Maths, others none.

faculties.name: College of Business
faculties.line: Accounting, Finance, Marketing; 80% in English and Maths (or SAT Math 530).

faculties.name: College of Communication and Media Sciences
faculties.line: Three concentrations; 80% in English and in Arabic, no Maths needed.

faculties.name: College of Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: International Studies (two concentrations); 80% in English, no Maths or science.

faculties.name: College of Natural and Health Sciences
faculties.line: Psychology, Public Health, Environmental Science; Maths 80% and, for some, one science at 80%.

faculties.name: College of Technological Innovation
faculties.line: IT and Intelligent Systems Engineering; Maths 80%, engineering needs Physics plus a science.

languageOfInstruction.note: English proof is required for every degree, but no explicit language-of-instruction sentence was found; Media and Communication also needs Arabic.

admissionRoutes.text: A Diploma of at least 24 points meets the secondary completion rule; each degree adds English, Maths and science minimums.
IB certificate holders need at least 21 points including two subjects related to the degree, each at grade 4 or higher.
